title: Palliative care and heart failure
organization: Heart Failure Matters / European Society of Cardiology
usable_for: anchors heart failure as progressive, unpredictable, and compatible with concurrent supportive/palliative care
do_not_use_for: predicting an individual time of death or converting a trajectory into a countdown
diagnosis, treatment selection, eligibility decisions, hospice certification, or medication/procedure guidance
claiming that one trajectory describes every person with the named condition
substituting for the person’s local clinicians, palliative team, disease specialist, hospice, emergency services, or care plan
extracting private bedside testimony or identifiable family details without consent
extraction_rules: extract vocabulary, course-shape context, common family-language questions, and review gates
separate trajectory orientation from prognosis and from clinical instructions
preserve uncertainty, mixed trajectories, and source limitations
route condition-specific care questions back to qualified local clinicians and care teams
review_notes: Card created in rev0010 for the trajectory-axis layer.
